title: Find a recorded track (CC0 / CC BY) by feel and length
what_it_does: Searches Openverse for a CC0 or CC BY track that fits a mood and length, downloads it, records it as used so the next video gets a different one, and writes the attribution line the video needs.
when_to_use: When the person has no track of their own for a video that needs music. The person's own track always comes first; with no network or no fitting result the video is delivered without music and that is said. A CC BY track always needs its credit in the share copy.
notes: The licence field is for our code. The tracks it finds are CC0 or CC BY, and CC BY needs attribution (creditFor builds it). Needs network; that is why it is opt-in with --source openverse. Builtin: a command of this CLI; add only records it in the studio.
